days.title: High Peaks and Ancient Waters
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lago degli Idoli
stops.detail: The history of this territory begins in ancient times, with the first Etruscan settlements that found in "Lago degli Idoli" the most important site of the Tuscan-Romagnolo Apennines (at the foot of Monte Falterona) where they could worship their deities.

stops.name: Monte Falterona
stops.detail: The altitudes of the Park vary from 400 to 1,658 meters: Monte Falco (1,658 m) and Monte Falterona (1,654 m), from which the Arno river rises, are the highest peaks.

stops.name: Monte Falco
stops.detail: The highest peak in the Park, Monte Falco, also has an Integral Nature Reserve on its northern slope.

stops.name: San Benedetto in Alpe
stops.detail: The territory of the Park is also characterized by the presence of inhabited centers rich in history, such as Badia Prataglia, Camaldoli, La Verna, and San Benedetto in Alpe.

stops.name: invaso artificiale di Ridracoli
stops.detail: Natural lake basins are absent, while there is the presence of the artificial reservoir of Ridracoli which holds about 33 million cubic meters of water from the basin of the Bidente arm of the same name and from those of Corniolo and Rabbi.
